statement: Dependency B for the raft-rs partition snapshot ownership work repairs only the existing per-replica lifecycle, durable-record and local-open storage interaction. Starting from exact clean 82b54ef9b7c8d6be9f2d6450cbc5e6713ade00af or its reviewed successor at seal time, opening a local raft-rs partition replica consumes target-local durable facts from their owners: peer identity and reservations, lifecycle/incarnation, durable record, HardState term/vote, log, snapshot/applied state, ConfState and membership generation. Virgin storage can initialize through the ordinary owner path; intact coherent storage opens without needing a fresh majority proof; legal vote 0 and coherent local lag are valid. Missing, unreadable, corrupt, noncanonical or internally contradictory local facts refuse before unsafe participation, or return a typed owner failure, without fabricating absence, HOLD, install authority, campaign, vote or a second ACTIVE lifecycle row. A readable current database with authoritative prior existence but absent durable raft record is KNOWN_WIPE and produces the existing reseed-required HOLD before native core entry; same-byte restart repeats the refusal and preserves the exact HOLD identity. Read-unavailable is distinct from missing/corrupt facts and blocks only the transition whose fact owner is unavailable. Three intact voters can cold restart from their own durable files without a pre-existing live leader, elect and commit an ordinary entry. This Quest does not create snapshot images, publish native snapshots, stage or install an accepted image, assert any accepted-image transaction, add a majority token, reconstruct a wiped voter as the same identity, use a late pre-create_node observer mutation as a CAS oracle, change FreshMG, or claim the final R1-R7 catch-up interaction.

constraints.statement: Scope is limited to LOCAL_OPEN, KNOWN_WIPE, READ_UNAVAILABLE and intact cold restart for existing local storage. Sender publication, transfer, receiver Ready admission, application image import, atomic accepted-image transaction, report_snapshot feedback, cleanup/deletion and FreshMG remain outside this Quest.

Opening consumes exact target-local owners for peer identity/reservations, lifecycle/incarnation, durable record, HardState, log, snapshot/applied, ConfState and generation. Wrong group, peer, replica or incarnation cannot mint a second ACTIVE row or enter native core as if it were the original replica.

Absent, unreadable, corrupt, noncanonical or contradictory local facts refuse before unsafe core participation or return a typed owner failure. Each refusal proves no unsafe install, campaign, vote, same-identity participation, second ACTIVE lifecycle row or fabricated HOLD. Read-unavailable remains retryable/typed and never becomes absence.

Virgin creation, intact coherent reopen, legal vote0, coherent lag and three-voter cold restart remain lawful positives. A repair cannot make safe ordinary restart depend on current majority proof or current applied equality.

Known wipe requires readable current storage, authoritative prior existence and absent durable raft record. It persists current-DB reseed-required HOLD before native core entry, and same-byte restart repeats the refusal with the same logical identity. Manual old-image rollback or restoring a previous whole replica DB is unsupported and excluded.

The late pre-create_node observer mutation schedule is diagnostic only and cannot serve as lawful pre-open CAS proof. Candidate proof must use existing owner yield points or approved transaction-boundary/local-open owner checks.

The Quest uses the existing scripts/quest-evidence/harness-runtime.js runner to produce a test-receipt artifact. Baseline red must be a genuine owner red with runner output preserved; skip/todo/zero-selected/setup-only false greens are rejected.

Dependency B green receipts do not satisfy the final coupled seven-scenario partition snapshot Quest. The final Quest must rerun this dependency evidence on its exact head and still prove R1-R7 source/receiver interaction, crash/lost response, physical atomicity and cleanup boundaries.
